name: Harbor Works desktop v0.15.2
title: Bring the Harbor Works desktop app onto Hermes 0.15.2
description: Fold in relevant Hermes desktop 0.15.2 changes while making Harbor Works the product source of truth: Harbor Works branding, Harbor Works provider/auth flows, OpenAI Codex support, working desktop model switching, and update paths that point at Harbor Works.

project_identity.upstream_policy: Review each upstream Hermes release and port only changes relevant to Harbor Works. Do not automatically replay the full upstream release.

dependencies.contract: The desktop app shells out to the Harbor Works CLI install/auth flow and reads long-lived ~/.hw credentials through the CLI-owned layout.
Harbor Works provider traffic routes through Harbor Engine; user-facing desktop model surfaces should show Harbor Works and OpenAI Codex only.
The desktop app icon uses the new Harbor Works lighthouse mark from the landing-page design system.

scope: Desktop package and runtime identity are Harbor Works, not Hermes
Desktop model/settings surfaces expose Harbor Works and OpenAI Codex only
Harbor Works CLI install and OAuth/auth flow can run in app
OpenAI Codex OAuth sign-in is available from desktop settings/provider setup
The /model command works in desktop for authenticated model switching
CLI and desktop update paths point at Harbor Works where applicable
The harness records Harbor Works as the product source of truth and treats upstream Hermes as reviewed input, not an automatic base
out_of_scope: Broad upstream desktop redesign beyond required Harbor Works identity and provider/auth flows
Replacing the Hermes backend/runtime package names where they are still implementation details
Raw provider-key routing for managed Harbor Works flows
Automatic wholesale replay of every upstream Hermes release
